visualReview: Both32-frame contact pages personally inspected. Eight bearings with genuine reach/pull/tuck/push articulation; front-right7 subsequently regenerated toward viewer to separate from profile6. Far-limb occlusion, source identity variation and exact wall registration remain unaccepted.
knownLimits: This reach/pull/tuck/push sequence differs from earlier contralateral diagnostics; no relabeling of old poses.
Tuck strongly compresses silhouette through knee flexion; far hand/foot occlusion is not fully anatomically validated.
Contact planes, fixed grip registration and physical weight transfer remain unaccepted.
Face, cloth, pouch placement and camera angle vary across independent bearings. Bearing7 camera was repaired; exact cross-bearing consistency remains unaccepted.
Exact native palette and runtime size/temporal behavior remain unvalidated.
